name: What should I consider when choosing between a new construction luxury condo and a resale in Miami Beach?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing between a new construction luxury condo and a resale in Miami Beach?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing between new construction and resale luxury condos in Miami Beach, consider several factors. New construction often features modern designs, updated building codes, and access to the latest amenities, but may involve waiting for completion and potential construction delays. Resale units offer immediate occupancy and established communities, but might require renovations or have older systems. The market conditions can also impact pricing, with new construction often commanding a premium. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution can provide insights into both options, helping you weigh the pros and cons based on your preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: New construction offers modern features and latest amenities but may involve delays, while resale units offer immediate occupancy but might need updates. Consider occupancy timing and potential renovations.
